messages:
maria-ops: Heads up — seeing ~12% GPU eviction rate in ap-south2 (zonal pool z3). Multiple customers reporting 503s for text-generation routes. Raising an incident and starting triage.

ashwin-eng-sre: On it. Observing host-level preemption and repeated driver restarts in the syslog on 3 hosts (z3-07/08/09). Control-plane healthchecks flapping for the pool. Collecting dmesg + nvidia-smi logs now.

julian-eng-runtime: Runtime telemetry shows KV cache growth for long-chat sessions (llama-70b-prod). Memory pressure causing OOM evictions when concurrent batch jobs spike. Suggest we shed background batches and throttle long-lived sessions temporarily.

maria-ops: Agreed. Ops plan: controlled drain of z3 pool and steer new sessions to ap-southeast1 where capacity headroom exists. Support — prepare customer comms.

ashwin-eng-sre: Kicking off controlled traffic shift: `rctl traffic-shift --from=ap-south2 --to=ap-southeast1 --percent=60 --mode=gradual` (will ramp over 5m). Also starting kernel rollback on the 3 flapping hosts to 525.89 to see if driver stability improves.

erin-support: Drafting status post. Proposed short note: "Performance degradation in ap-south2 affecting generation models; traffic being shifted; mitigation in progress; ETA 2 hours; updates every 15m." Can we confirm ETA and whether we auto-migrate reserved customers?

maria-ops: ETA estimate: 2 hours for stabilization if rollback + shift behaves. Do NOT auto-migrate reserved/dedicated customers — we'll PM them. Affected reserved accounts: AcmeCorp, BoltAI (private notice only). Public status will mention "some reserved capacity customers may be impacted".

julian-eng-runtime: Also enabling a soft KV cap for noisy tenants to reduce OOM churn: `curl -XPOST https://cfg.redwood.internal/runtime -d '{"kv_cap":1500000, "scope":"tenant_unsafe"}'` — will apply to top offenders.

statusbot: Incident INC-2026-527 created, severity P2. Statuspage draft saved: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-527 — posting on confirm.

erin-support: Posted public status and emailed impacted reserved customers. Message includes private escalation link and our SRE contact alias. Will open tickets for any enterprise customers hitting SLA thresholds.

maria-ops: Initial metrics after 10m of shift: eviction rate down from 12% -> 7%, queue depth reduced ~30%, but 99th latency still elevated on ap-south2 ~2.1x baseline. Continue monitoring.

ashwin-eng-sre: Kernel rollback logs show reduced driver restarts on z3-07/08, z3-09 still noisy. If noise persists after 20m, plan B is rolling reprovision to driver 528 with `nvidia.NVreg_ResmanEnabled=0` kernel arg — more invasive and will take ~4-6h including reprovision & safety checks. That option increases temporary spend due to spare nodes.

maria-ops: Decision: continue with rollback + traffic shift. Escalate to reprovision only if we don't see steady improvement in the next 40m. Support to send private notes to AcmeCorp/BoltAI and offer temporary quota reroute to ap-southeast1.

erin-support: Done — DMed leads at AcmeCorp and BoltAI with mitigation path and created support tickets #INC-527-A and #INC-527-B. Contact alias: support+enterprise@redwood.ai.

oncall-bot: Paging ashwin-eng-sre if incident not resolved by 2041213476 (1h drive window).

maria-ops: I'll post the next update in 15m or sooner if any major change. Thanks all — keep updates short and actions clear. :thumbsup:
